The machine\'s own figures. A night runs from midday to midday, and its figures arrive after it has ended. Leak and pressure are the values not exceeded for 95% of the night.

Use the machine\'s clock as it is now?

PAPRelay gives the nights since the last synchronisation times from the machine\'s clock as it is now. If the clock was changed after some of those nights, they get the wrong time. This cannot be undone.
PAPRelay writes every night the machine still holds to Health Connect again. Use this if the data in Health Connect was deleted.

PAPRelay transfers, stores, converts and displays data your machine has already recorded. It does not interpret the data, raise alerts, give advice or control the machine.

The device check reads from the machine and changes none of its settings or data. Pairing replaces the myAir app\'s connection to the machine. The check writes one test value to Health Connect and removes it again.

PAPRelay is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition, and must not be used to make diagnosis or treatment decisions. Values may be wrong, late or missing. It does not replace myAir, your equipment provider\'s reporting, or advice from a clinician.

What PAPRelay does with your data

PAPRelay reads therapy records from your machine over Bluetooth and stores them on this phone. If you leave it switched on, it writes each night\'s figures to the health records in Health Connect. If you switch it on, it writes respiratory rate to Health Connect, and a table of nights to a folder you choose. It does this when you ask, and from time to time in the background when the machine is in range.
Your data goes nowhere else. PAPRelay has no internet permission, no accounts, no analytics and no advertising. Data leaves the app only through Health Connect and through files you choose to save.
What PAPRelay reads from Health Connect
PAPRelay reads nothing from Health Connect. It asks only for permission to write.
Uninstalling PAPRelay deletes everything it stored. Records it wrote to Health Connect can be removed in Health Connect, under App permissions, PAPRelay.
